title: All-temperature pressure for orthogonally invariant Ising spin glasses

abstractEnglish: We determine the limiting pressure of an Ising spin glass with Haar orthogonal eigenvectors, a compact limiting spectral law, and no asymptotic outliers, at every fixed temperature. The pressure converges in expectation and almost surely to a variational formula. We also give the limiting pressure with deterministic external fields whose empirical laws converge in first-moment transport distance, and derive a formula for the zero-field ground-state energy by taking temperature to zero.
